posts.title: How many turtles does your AI eval need?
posts.description: Usage numbers don't tell you if your AI output is any good. Instead of building an LLM-as-a-judge eval pipeline, we measured AI quiz quality by comparing generated questions with what creators actually published, using a twenty-year-old metric and no model at all.

posts.title: Use it or lose it
posts.description: Skill atrophy works like any other atrophy, and the fix is the same, use the skill. One AI-free day a week is how I’m attempting to slow down the decay of my coding and critical thinking skills.

posts.title: Full-stack was never the whole stack - AI just made it obvious
posts.description: AI made writing code the cheap part. The bottleneck is now deciding what to build and checking whether it worked. Engineers who own that part are called product engineers, and you should try to become one.
